title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Release notes corrections, no behavior changes
summary: Maintenance patch correcting v1.16.0 release note text and version references; no changes to extension functionality.

highlights.title: Clarified Release Notes
highlights.description: The v1.16.0 changelog entries were reworded for precision — descriptions of suppression hover docs, dispatcher-aware suspend badges, and keyboard shortcuts are now clearer and more accurate.

highlights.title: Release Process Reliability
highlights.description: The publish workflow now automatically monitors CI after each push and reports pass/fail status, reducing the risk of a defective build reaching the marketplace undetected.

sections.heading: Notes
bullets: No changes to extension commands, settings, navigation, or any other user-facing behavior since v1.16.0.
